# Delytica MedSpa Growth Agency

> Delytica is a done-for-you AI automation and growth marketing agency for med spas and aesthetic medicine practices. We are not a medspa — we serve medspa owners.

## What We Do

Delytica eliminates the three structural revenue leaks in every med spa: unanswered calls, no-shows, and dormant patients who never return. We deploy proven automation infrastructure — not custom builds — so results arrive in days, not months.

## Services

### Practice Essentials — $297/month + $497 one-time setup
The intelligent care layer every practice needs before advertising.
- Instant patient response: automated reply when calls go unanswered, before patients call a competitor
- Appointment care sequences: tiered reminders that dramatically reduce no-shows
- Appointment recovery: reschedule sequences sent after every missed appointment
- Reputation cultivation: post-visit review prompts sent at the optimal moment
- Patient reactivation: monthly outreach to patients who haven't returned
- Unified patient communications: all messages (text, email, web) in one inbox

30-day guarantee: if system-tracked bookings don't hit the agreed target, the setup fee is refunded.

### Practice Growth — $697–$1,200/month
Everything in Practice Essentials plus:
- Rebooking sequences
- Membership growth campaigns
- 8–12 social posts/month
- Single-platform advertising (Meta or Google)
- Priority support

### Full Partnership — $1,800–$3,500/month
Everything in Practice Growth plus:
- Dual-channel advertising (Meta + Google)
- Custom content production
- Booking funnel optimization
- Monthly performance reporting
- Dedicated account contact

## Key Facts

- Platform: GoHighLevel (Agency Pro with HIPAA add-on)
- HIPAA-eligible infrastructure included at every tier from day one
- No long-term contracts on Practice Essentials (month-to-month after setup)
- Go-live time: 3–5 business days after onboarding
- Multi-location volume pricing available (setup discounts scale; monthly near list)
- Breakeven: approximately 3 clients covers platform cost
- Currently Phase 1: warm-network introductions only, first 10–15 clients get setup fee waived

## Target Clients

Single-location and multi-location med spa owners and aesthetic medicine practices in the United States.

## Market Context

The US med spa market is estimated at $9.3B in 2026, projected to reach $33.2B by 2035, growing at 15.2% CAGR. Most single-location practices are under-served on patient care between visits.

## Key Stats

- 17–22%: average no-show rate in practices without a care sequence
- 37%: first-visit patients who never return without follow-up
- ~3 clients: number needed to recover the full cost of Practice Essentials
